name: Nuclear exosome RNA decay and noncoding RNA 3'-end trimming
rationale: All members are nuclear 3'-to-5' exosome-mediated decay or 3'-end trimming of mRNA, snRNA, snoRNA, CUT and rRNA species, unlike confusables centred on endonucleolytic pre-rRNA cleavage, rRNA modification or cytoplasmic mRNA/tRNA decay.

qualifier: eosinophil and mast cell differentiation and activation
name: Th2, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation and activation
rationale: Members cover Th2 differentiation and IL-5 production together with eosinophil and mast cell differentiation, migration and activation, whereas confusables centre on IL-4/IL-13/IL-33 signaling, IgE switching and nematode response.

qualifier: TAK1/IKK downstream of TLR and NOD receptors
name: TLR/NOD-driven TAK1-IKK activation of NF-kB, JNK and p38
rationale: Members describe innate-receptor (TLR, NOD1/2, dectin-1, TNFSF) activation of TAK1 and IKK leading to canonical/noncanonical NF-kB, JNK and p38 signaling, while confusables emphasise TNFR1 signaling, linear ubiquitination, negative regulation or TBK1-IRF3 activation.

qualifier: lipid oxidation, protein import and isoprenoid/sterol synthesis
name: Peroxisomal lipid metabolism, protein import and sterol synthesis
rationale: Members span peroxisome biogenesis and protein import, peroxisomal alpha/beta-oxidation, VLCFA and ether-lipid synthesis and isoprenoid/cholesterol synthesis, distinguishing it from mitochondrial beta-oxidation, ketone and bile acid confusables.

qualifier: retinoic acid synthesis, catabolism and response
name: Vitamin A to retinoic acid metabolism and response
rationale: Members concern retinol/retinal/retinoic acid metabolism, CYP26-mediated RA degradation and cellular response to retinoic acid, unlike confusables on vitamin D, vitamin K or the visual retinoid cycle.

name: Monocyte inflammatory and TLR signaling signature
rationale: Members are monocyte/myeloid and DC inflammatory and TLR signaling modules (including endogenous-ligand TLR regulation), as opposed to LPS/TLR2 detection or neutrophil degranulation confusables.

core: Renal fluid and blood pressure control
name: Renin-angiotensin and vasopressin regulation of blood volume and pressure
rationale: Members cover angiotensin generation and signaling, vasopressin/AVPR-driven renal water reabsorption and renal sodium/urine volume control of blood pressure, whereas confusables centre on cGMP natriuretic signaling, aquaporin passive transport or osmotic stress responses.

name: IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 common gamma-chain cytokine signaling
rationale: All members are IL-2, IL-7 or IL-9 receptor signaling (with IL-2-STAT5), distinguishing them from IL-15/IL-21, IL-3/IL-5 or FLT3-STAT5 confusables.

name: Epithelial cell-cell junctions and adhesion
rationale: Members are general cell junction, apical junction and epithelial cell-cell adhesion sets including adherens junction maintenance and apoptotic cleavage of adhesion proteins, without the cadherin assembly, apical polarity or desmosome specifics of confusables.

name: Endosomal neurotransmitter receptor trafficking in postsynaptic plasticity
rationale: Members concern endosomal recycling and internalization of postsynaptic (AMPA) receptors, postsynaptic calcium and actin, LTD and short-term memory, unlike presynaptic vesicle-cycle, BDNF/TRK or receptor clustering confusables.

qualifier: acyl-CoA and NAD(P) handling rather than fatty acid oxidation
name: Peroxisomal acyl-CoA and NAD(P) cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members are small peroxisome-associated activities (NAD transport, NADP+ synthesis, malonyl-, succinyl- and medium-chain acyl-CoA metabolism, TYSND1 processing), lacking the alpha/beta-oxidation and VLCFA pathways of confusables.

name: miRNA biogenesis regulation and fibroblast-driven connective tissue repair
rationale: Members combine regulation of pri/pre-miRNA processing and miRNA transcription with fibroblast survival, myofibroblast differentiation, connective tissue replacement and dampened TGF-beta response, whereas confusables lack miRNA processing and centre on ECM, collagen or SMAD signaling.

name: RUNX1-regulated myeloid progenitor and megakaryocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover RUNX1-driven HSC/myeloid progenitor programmes and megakaryocyte/platelet development, distinct from confusables focused on erythroid maturation, granulopoiesis or monocyte/macrophage differentiation.

name: Nucleoside triphosphate hydrolysis by Nudix phosphatases
rationale: All members are catabolism of (ribo/purine) nucleoside triphosphates, the NUDT reaction set, whereas confusables concern deoxynucleoside/nucleotide catabolism, nucleoside transport or purine nucleoside degradation.

name: Glucose-sensing ChREBP and glucagon-PKA metabolic signaling
rationale: Members cover glucose/carbon-catabolite control of transcription via ChREBP and its regulation by glucagon-PKA, AMPK, PP2A and PDE3B, distinguishing them from LXR, PPARA, SREBP or circadian nuclear-receptor confusables.

name: Mesenchymal cell proliferation and epithelial-mesenchymal signaling
rationale: Members concern mesenchymal cell proliferation and reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung mesenchyme and limb bud, while confusables centre on epithelial branching of salivary, prostate or pancreatic glands.

name: Mammary gland epithelial development and lactation
rationale: All members concern mammary stem, luminal, myoepithelial and alveolar lineage development, duct branching, thelarche and lactation, distinct from prostate, placental or reproductive-tract confusables.

qualifier: beta-oxidation of very long and branched chains
name: Peroxisomal very-long-chain fatty acid beta-oxidation
rationale: Members are acyl-CoA oxidase-dependent beta-oxidation of very-long-chain, long/medium-chain and pristanoyl-CoA substrates including ABCD1 defects, unlike confusables on peroxisomal synthesis, alpha-oxidation or cofactor metabolism.

qualifier: de novo synthesis and cardiolipin/PG remodeling
name: De novo glycerophospholipid and cardiolipin synthesis and turnover
rationale: Members cover CDP-DAG and CDP-choline routes to PE, PC, PS, PG and cardiolipin, PG/CL acyl remodeling and lysophospholipid hydrolysis, distinct from Lands-cycle remodeling of PC/PE/PI/PS and PI synthesis confusables.

name: Mitotic kinase signaling in spindle assembly and checkpoint
rationale: Members describe PLK1, Aurora A and NEK kinase regulation of mitotic entry, centrosome separation, spindle formation and the spindle checkpoint, unlike confusables on centrosome protein recruitment, sister chromatid cohesion or cytokinesis/midzone.

qualifier: Fas-mediated death of activated T cells and thymocytes
name: Fas-mediated apoptosis of activated T cells and thymocytes
rationale: Members cover FasL signaling, BID activation, activation-induced T cell death, thymocyte apoptosis and T cell signaling/allograft modules, distinguishing them from TRAIL, caspase-8/c-FLIP or hepatocyte death-receptor confusables.

qualifier: biogenesis, RISC assembly and miRNA decay
name: miRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and miRNA decay
rationale: Members cover miRNA biogenesis, RISC loading, target-directed miRNA degradation and silencing by mRNA destabilization, whereas confusables emphasise translational repression, P-body/deadenylation control or siRNA processing.

qualifier: amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Analgesic drug metabolism and amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
rationale: Members are glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate plus aspirin, paracetamol, prednisone and CYP2E1 drug metabolism, distinct from acetylation/methylation or other drug ADME confusables.

name: FLT3 mutant resistance to tamatinib, ponatinib and lestaurtinib
rationale: All members are FLT3 mutants resistant to tamatinib, ponatinib or lestaurtinib, separating them from other FLT3 drug-resistance, KIT resistance and FLT3 signaling confusables.

name: Pyroptosis via caspase-4/5, AIM2 and NLRC4 inflammasomes
rationale: Members cover pyroptotic cell death driven by noncanonical caspase-4/5, AIM2 and IPAF/NLRC4 inflammasomes, unlike confusables centred on NLRP1/NLRP3 and IL-1/IL-18 processing.
